rows.grounds: compound of pūrvatra (before) and anvaya (connection); sandhi fuses final a of pūrvatra with initial a of anvaya into ā

items.question: How does the remainder of the rite connect to the previously described mandala and its elements?
premises: remainder connects to prior mandala description
items.inference: The verse asserts continuity between the remainder and earlier mandala instructions.
uncertainties: exact scope of the remainder is unspecified
which prior elements are included is not explicit
items.plain_english: The rest is connected with what was said before.
